purpose: Test whether one speech-semantic organization contact followed by deterministic retrieval and supply of exactly one values-stripped registry row yields deployment-visible information and a cross-fitted training-free controller that improves on frozen M0.

predecessor.verdict: schema risk was live but did not separate useful from harmful returns; both policies stopped on all 104 samples
predecessor.required_change: change information acquisition or evidence generation without tuning another state category or threshold on the predecessor returns

unchanged: frozen core and API-shaped service boundary
official scorer and exact-match primary outcome
single_information_change.changed: replace direct self-consistency and union supply with a structured speech-semantic factor observation, deterministic BM25 top-1 registry retrieval, and exactly one values-stripped registry-row supply
not_allowed: tool identity, domain, category, sample identity, tier, gold, reward, or future response in a policy state
post-result factor-schema, retriever, state-bin, support, harm, or promotion-threshold changes

population.strata: 13 samples per tier across all eight tiers
population.exposure: fully exposed discovery cohort; all findings are secondary mechanism evidence only

frozen_m0_outputs.semantics: one-call baseline and STOP_M0 output, reused without model contact

agent_loop.frozen_core: Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B-Instruct Q4_K_M through the receipt-pinned local llama.cpp service
agent_loop.speech_carriage: the exact original speech-feature packet remains the primary query on every model contact
agent_loop.phase_1: ORG_FACTORS: one bounded speech-conditioned contact requests a raw JSON factor object; the external strict parser accepts only the frozen schema and otherwise marks the factor invalid
agent_loop.phase_2: RETRIEVE_TOP1: deterministic local BM25 ranks the frozen registry and selects at most one row; no model, tokenizer, embedding, HTTP, or socket contact
agent_loop.phase_3: USE_FACTOR_TOP1: one final frozen-core contact sees the original speech and canonical factor state; it sees exactly one values-stripped retrieved registry row when available and a fixed no-factor sentinel with no supplied value otherwise
agent_loop.stop_semantics: return the frozen M0 response after the factor contact; the factor response is never itself a final answer
agent_loop.candidate_unavailable_semantics: the discovery arm still records one diagnostic phase-3 response with no supplied registry value, but scoring-side composition excludes that response and forces STOP_M0; a deployed policy never spends this unavailable phase-3 contact
agent_loop.final_authority: only the phase-3 frozen-core response or frozen M0 can be the task answer

factor_schema.enforcement: external exact post-response validation because the receipt-pinned peg-native server rejects response_format JSON-schema generation before returning a usable response
factor_schema.task_action: ASCII English semantic phrase, zero to 80 characters
factor_schema.task_object: ASCII English semantic phrase, zero to 80 characters
factor_schema.qualifiers: zero to four ASCII English phrases, each at most 80 characters
factor_schema.argument_hints: zero to four objects with ASCII role and value_hint fields, each at most 80 characters
factor_schema.instruction: Analyze the original speech without transcribing it. Describe task semantics in English. Do not name, choose, or emit a tool or tool-call list. Return one raw JSON object with the exact required fields in assistant content.
factor_schema.canonicalization: parse the exact object, reject extra fields or non-ASCII/non-English-control text, trim and collapse whitespace, preserve field order, sort and deduplicate qualifier and argument-hint tuples
factor_schema.invalid_semantics: no retrieval; a fixed English sentinel replaces the rejected factor before the diagnostic phase-3 contact, and scoring-side composition forces STOP_M0

retriever.tokenization: lowercase ASCII alphanumeric tokens after camel-case splitting
retriever.candidate_rule: select exactly one highest-scoring positive-score row; break a top-score tie by ascending numeric tool_id while recording tied-top state
retriever.unavailable_rule: no positive lexical score means no candidate
retriever.supply_renderer: canonical registry JSON with argument_defaults removed and every other field unchanged
invariances: consistent tool-id renumbering after preserving numeric order does not change scores

coarse: factor uncertainty: low, medium, high, unavailable
retrieved top-1 relation to M0 parsed tool set: m0-contains-top1, m0-known-disagrees, m0-unresolved, unavailable
detailed_additions: positive-score document count: one, two-to-five, six-or-more, unavailable
matched factor-token fraction: none, minority-below-one-half, majority-at-least-one-half
nonempty semantic field count: zero, one, two, three-or-more
forbidden: literal factor strings or argument values
sample id, query_idx, rendition id, tier, or fold as a feature
gold labels, correctness, score, reward, phase-3 response, or future turn

training_free_reward_memory.type: five-fold whole-query-group cross-fitted hierarchical exact-cell action-return memory
training_free_reward_memory.decision: use the most-specific other-fold matching cell, detailed before coarse; select USE_FACTOR_TOP1 only with support at least four, at least two saves, and zero harms; otherwise STOP_M0
training_free_reward_memory.candidate_selection: among candidates passing every gate, maximize cross-fitted exact-match net gain, then saved exact matches, then minimize phase-3 contacts, then lexical candidate id
training_free_reward_memory.contact_accounting: every deployed sample pays one factor contact; only USE_FACTOR_TOP1 pays a second new contact; frozen M0 is reported as the one-call baseline

resend_control.selection: after candidate availability is known but before any result is semantically read, choose two available samples per tier by the smallest SHA-256 of resend-v1 plus sample_id; fail closed if any tier has fewer than two available samples
resend_control.protocol: repeat the byte-identical phase-3 request in a separate workflow with the same contact id, decoding parameters, factor state, supplied row, and speech packet
resend_control.scoring: create a complete 104-row resend-composite manifest by replacing only the 16 selected main responses and retaining the other 88 main or STOP_M0 responses
resend_control.floor: record byte divergence, parsed-call divergence, exact-match divergence, and the absolute main-versus-resend-composite exact-count difference
resend_control.promotion_binding: cross-fitted policy exact gain must exceed the measured absolute complete-manifest resend exact-count difference

evaluation.seal_before_score: factor, main phase-3, and resend contacts seal before gold or scorer results are opened
evaluation.official_scorer: one unchanged complete-manifest invocation for the main composite and one for the resend composite

outer_parallelism.aggregation: no dataset sharding and no averaging of shard-level metrics

mandatory_reports: M0, always-use main composite, resend composite, and cross-fitted policy exact match, tool accuracy, and slot micro-F1
factor parse rate, nonempty rate, uncertainty distribution, and prohibited-tool-name leakage count
top-1 availability, score-tie rate, top-1 gold-tool accuracy, and delta from M0 tool accuracy
saves, harms, net gain, final-action rate, factor contacts, phase-3 contacts, and total contacts per sample
all eight tiers without tier-conditioned tuning and all five query-group folds
resend byte, parsed-call, metric, timing, and slot-id divergence
parallel scorer wall time, per-job time, effective speedup, result hashes, and scorer identity

decision_ladder.failure: write a negative artifact, close semantic-factor-to-BM25-top1 single-row supply on this cohort, and make no fresh-sample contact
decision_ladder.success: freeze one actual controller proposal and preregister a fresh approximately-104-sample support flight drawn without gold from the remaining exposed discovery population
decision_ladder.support_success: only a separately registered stable prospective gain may propose a larger Stage-2 candidate or Stage-3 promotion; no approximately-1000-sample run is authorized here
decision_ladder.no_failure_followup: do not expand k, add a candidate menu, retune BM25, alter state bins, or relax policy/promotion gates on these returns

precontact_requirements: structured contracts.ExecutionPlan committed with this row as exposure_pre_registration_id
split identity, protocol hash, source hashes, packet receipt, runtime receipt, and attempt budget validated fail-closed
factor-schema, English/ASCII, prohibited-tool-name, retriever-invariance, single-row renderer, prompt-fit, and composite-manifest gates pass
